name: Erin Miller
title: Executive Chef & Owner
bio: Erin Miller is the Founder, Owner, and Chef of Urban Hearth, which she opened in Cambridge, Massachusetts, in 2016. Urban Hearth is Michelin-recommended and was ranked No. 6 on Boston Magazine's Top 50 Restaurants in 2025. It has also won Boston Magazine's Best of Boston for Best Farm-to-Table Restaurant (2022), Best Chef's Counter (2024), and Boston's Best Locavore Restaurant (2025). The dining room serves à la carte shared plates, and the six-seat Chef's Counter, open five nights a week, is a tasting menu where the chef cooks and plates every course and talks guests through each one.

A 2025 James Beard Award nominee for Best Chef: Northeast and participant in the James Beard Foundation's Women's Entrepreneurial Leadership (WEL) program, Erin is classically trained at the French Culinary Institute in New York and honed her craft in acclaimed kitchens, including Dan Barber's Blue Hill. Her cooking is guided by the seasons, shaped by close relationships with farmers, fishermen, and foragers, and grounded in a belief that restaurants can be powerful forces for both community and environmental stewardship.

Beyond the kitchen, Erin is passionate about mentorship and creating opportunities for the next generation of hospitality professionals. She is committed to building a restaurant culture that values curiosity, craftsmanship, sustainability, and care for guests, employees, and the broader food system alike.

Originally from the Blue Ridge Mountains of Virginia, Erin has called Cambridge home since 2008, where she lives with her husband and two sons. When not in the kitchen, she spends time hiking, foraging, and traveling. Her recent adventures include walking the length of Hadrian’s Wall in England and biking the Rhone Valley with her son.
